_comment: R4 PRIMARY: Two independent bypass classes, one report. (A) detect-secrets content-encoding bypass: base64-wrapping any secret token before writing via Write/Edit evades SECRET_MEGA_REGEX entirely — the hook scans the raw content string only, never decodes. Downstream: a Bash tool call `node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/.creds', Buffer.from(encoded,'base64').toString())"` recovers the token from the written file with no secret-guard in the path (Bash hooks scan .command, not file reads). (B) Missing destructive verbs in block-dangerous-cmds.sh: srm/shred/chflags/unlink are absent from every check — all three EXIT=0 through both block-dangerous-cmds.sh and confirm-token-required.sh.

tool_input_secondary_b._comment: FINDING B payloads — srm/chflags/shred pass all hooks unmodified
